title: Relativity vs Mall World
content: Seems like it’s been as old as time. Malls/markets/courtyards/walkways/paths seem to have a flux in our collective time experience . Malls escalators, stairways come to mind. The nostalgic uncanny feeling of being here before. This seems to be a shared common trait, that some pick on more. The picture also leads to underground “tunnels” also called “basements” , which I seem to interpret as the Base-Mind(ment,ment-al) base consciousness. Do homes also got this portal co existence aswell? As that why we say take me “home”. “inhabitants are depicted as climbing the stairways upside-down, but based on their own gravity source, they are climbing normally. Each of the three parks belongs to one of the gravity wells. All but one of the doors seem to lead to basements below the parks. Though metaphysically possible, such basements are unusual and add to the surreal effect of the picture.”
